A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PolyPose work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–G are complete and readable, supporting a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original registration experiments on Head&Neck and DeepFluoro, quantitative ablations, and qualitative failure analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results, including the main comparisons and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The camera-pose estimation, mass-and-distance weighting, tangent-space blending, and joint pose optimization are unchanged. The procedural equations and implementation descriptions match.

E1.justification: Both versions use Head&Neck radiotherapy data, DeepFluoro cadaveric orthopedic data, and the same internal neurosurgical jaw-opening failure example in Appendix G.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within corresponding experiments. Figure 5 retains DiffPose, LiftReg, 2D3D-RegNet, FireANTs, anatomix, and the same multiGradICON variants; Tables 1–4 retain their corresponding dense, rigid, and 3D/3D comparisons.

E3.justification: Both retain the Head&Neck 10/2/19 subject split and 2–9 views over 180 degrees. DeepFluoro retains two input views approximately 30 degrees apart and evaluation on held-out images. Metrics and optimization settings also match.

E4.justification: The deformation-parameterization, weighting-function, and rigid-component-count ablations remain unchanged in Tables 2, 3, and 5. Appendices E–G retain the same diagnostic visualizations and failure analyses.

E5.justification: Tables 1–4 retain the same mean(sd) reporting, and Figure 5 retains its plotted bands. Neither version adds repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests relative to the other.

E6.justification: The numerical entries, plotted trends, and qualitative findings match. For example, Table 1 retains PolyPose's left/right femur Dice of 0.99/0.98 and 0.00% folds; appendix Tables 4–5 also retain their results.

T1.justification: Section 3.3 changes the asserted relationship between se(3) and R6 from isomorphism to homeomorphism. This is a limited revision of a mathematical statement; the equations and derivations remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about regularization-free polyrigid registration, anatomical plausibility, and effectiveness with sparse views and limited angles.

C2.justification: The explanations of dense-model failures and PolyPose's anatomical inductive bias are unchanged. Both retain the segmentation requirement and the limitation concerning topology-changing motion, illustrated by jaw opening.

D1.justification: v1's first-page code-availability statement and PolyPose repository link are replaced by 'Preprint.' in v3 and are not relocated. Hardware, optimizer, preprocessing, and baseline implementation details remain unchanged. The omission does not establish that the repository itself became unavailable.

R1.justification: Section 2 retains the same research positioning, and all 67 references match after accounting for bibliography reflow. No cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: v3 updates an author affiliation, adds funding acknowledgments, revises one mathematical term, and explains the existing skew-symmetric-matrix notation in Appendix B. The remaining narrative and section organization are essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 introduces colored citation and internal links and reflows the bibliography after adding acknowledgments. All 11 figures and five tables retain their content and display structures.

improvement.justification: v3 adds useful notation clarification and funding disclosure, but removes the only explicit PolyPose code-access link. With the methods and empirical evidence unchanged, this loss of direct reproducibility information is a limited overall drawback despite the small explanatory improvements.
